changed.summary: Commissioned the autonomous pipeline that produced this frontier draft.

Regenerated #6 with the Quartet's edits: the sim-vs-obs SFMS over-evolution gap is now stated as a conservative LOWER BOUND (de-biasing the emission-line selection can only widen it: +0.41/+0.49 -> +0.46/+0.83 dex, sign robust across all 9 selection configs); added the +0.13 dex TNG aperture/mass-basis correction (common to the z~0 anchor and high z, so it cancels in the internal-evolution differencing -> result robust to it); showed the apparent metallicity discrepancy dissolves on a matched Te-anchored scale. Descriptive - not validated.
